items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: and had Bab Frank on a piccolo

ctx.x: Yeah, it was after that. Yeah,

yeah, it was after that. So, they remind of a place and it says he wanted me to get the greatest musicians they had in the town. so I gotten Pete Buckeyes, I got George P on trombone, got on the triet on trumpets, and I had old man's papatio and big birds on clarinet, and had Bab Frank on a piccolo. And we had Nookie Johnson, a nice ceremony entertainer. He's the one passed that hat around. I was sorry, we were on a dollar quarter night. But, collections were so great.
I didn't know that papatio ever played in a past time.
